title: Identification of TRPC6 as a Novel Diagnostic Biomarker of PM-Induced Chronic Obstructive Pulmonary Disease Using Machine Learning Models.
authors: Dhong, Kyu-Ree; Lee, Jae-Hyeong; Yoon, You-Rim; Park, Hye-Jin
one_liner_zh: 该研究用机器学习筛选COPD诊断生物标志物TRPC6，仅涉及基因表达和DNA结合注释，无蛋白质-DNA互作建模或TF-DNA机制研究，与本课题关联微弱。
abstract: Chronic obstructive pulmonary disease (COPD) was the third most prevalent cause of mortality worldwide in 2010; it results from a progressive and fatal deterioration of lung function because of cigarette smoking and particulate matter (PM). Therefore, it is important to identify molecular biomarkers that can diagnose the COPD phenotype to plan therapeutic efficacy. To identify potential novel biomarkers of COPD, we first obtained COPD and the normal lung tissue gene expression dataset GSE151052 from the NCBI Gene Expression Omnibus (GEO). A total of 250 differentially expressed genes (DEGs) were investigated and analyzed using GEO2R, gene ontology (GO) functional annotation, and Kyoto Encyclopedia of Genes and Genomes (KEGG) identification. The GEO2R analysis revealed that TRPC6 was the sixth most highly expressed gene in patients with COPD. The GO analysis indicated that the upregulated DEGs were mainly concentrated in the plasma membrane, transcription, and DNA binding. The KEGG pathway analysis indicated that the upregulated DEGs were mainly involved in pathways related to cancer and axon guidance. TRPC6, one of the most abundant genes among the top 10 differentially expressed total RNAs (fold change >/= 1.5) between the COPD and normal groups, was selected as a novel COPD biomarker based on the results of the GEO dataset and analysis using machine learning models. The upregulation of TRPC6 was verified in PM-stimulated RAW264.7 cells, which mimicked COPD conditions, compared to untreated RAW264.7 cells by a quantitative reverse transcription polymerase chain reaction. In conclusion, our study suggests that TRPC6 can be regarded as a potential novel biomarker for COPD pathogenesis.
abstract_zh: 慢性阻塞性肺疾病（COPD）在2010年是全球第三大死亡原因；它由吸烟和颗粒物（PM）导致肺功能进行性且致命性恶化所致。因此，识别能够诊断COPD表型的分子生物标志物以规划治疗效果至关重要。为识别COPD潜在的新型生物标志物，我们首先从NCBI基因表达综合数据库（GEO）获取了COPD和正常肺组织基因表达数据集GSE151052。共250个差异表达基因（DEGs）通过GEO2R、基因本体论（GO）功能注释和京都基因与基因组百科全书（KEGG）鉴定进行了研究和分析。GEO2R分析显示，TRPC6在COPD患者中表达量排名第六。GO分析表明，上调的DEGs主要集中于质膜、转录和DNA结合。KEGG通路分析显示，上调的DEGs主要涉及与癌症和轴突导向相关的通路。TRPC6是COPD与正常组之间前10个差异表达总RNA（倍数变化 ≥ 1.5）中最丰富的基因之一，基于GEO数据集结果和机器学习模型分析，被选为新型COPD生物标志物。在模拟COPD条件的PM刺激的RAW264.7细胞中，与未处理的RAW264.7细胞相比，通过定量逆转录聚合酶链反应验证了TRPC6的上调。总之，我们的研究表明，TRPC6可被视为COPD发病机制的潜在新型生物标志物。
